Last 15 minutes show net outflow to sellers at 8.66 SOL against 9.46 SOL bought, with 29 sellers, and the price is flat from the 30-minute high. If the desk ever revisits, the minimum bar would be a visibly distributed buyer set and sustained net inflow over several windows, not a single flat 15-minute bar.
